title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + init-hook/rollback compatibility for private-installer
author: Aisha Rao
description: Context: private-installer Helm chart has drifted across releases: values schema changes and init-job semantics caused upgrade failures (stuck init jobs) and unpredictable rollback behavior. This PR standardizes the values.schema, adds defensive templating for deprecated keys, and converts the init job to a pre-install/pre-upgrade hook with better ownership/cleanup semantics. Motivation: reduce upgrade pain during customer Private upgrades and make rollback behavior deterministic. Changes included: - Introduce values.schema.json with documented deprecated/alias mappings - Templating guards that read new OR legacy keys (values aliases) to preserve backwards compatibility for existing installs - Move init scripts into a Helm hook (pre-upgrade/pre-install) with deletionPolicy: before-hook-creation and proper pod anti-affinity to avoid scheduling conflicts - Add post-rollback cleanup hook to ensure partial resources (jobs, leases) are removed on failed upgrades - Improve templating around KMS and network overlays (explicit nil checks) - Add unit tests for Helm template rendering and an e2e chart upgrade/rollback test matrix Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json added and validated by CI - [x] aliasing logic implemented for legacy values - [x] init-job -> hook migration with lifecycle tests - [x] added Helm template unit tests and CI steps - [x] documented values deprecation in chart README Related: ENG-2781 (upgrade reliability), SUP-1023 (customer upgrade incident).
commits: 4c9b7e2: chore(helm): add values.schema.json and schema docs
a7d3f11: feat(helm): alias legacy values for upgrades (kms -> keyManagement, network overlays)
b1e5c3a: feat(helm): convert init job to pre-upgrade/pre-install hook with cleanup policy
d02f4b9: fix(helm): defensive templating for nil values and lists
e9c8a57: test(helm): add template unit tests + upgrade/rollback e2e scenario
f72b9d0: docs(chart): document deprecated keys and migration guide
changed_files: charts/private/templates/init-job.yaml -> charts/private/templates/hooks/init-hook.yaml (migrated to hook, added annotations 'helm.sh/hook': pre-install,pre-upgrade and 'helm.sh/hook-delete-policy': before-hook-creation)
charts/private/templates/_helpers.tpl - add helpers to resolve .Values aliases (e.g. .Values.kms | default .Values.keyManagement)
charts/private/templates/deployment.yaml - add nil checks for .Values.network.overlays and graceful defaults
charts/private/templates/rollback-cleanup-job.yaml - new post-rollback hook to delete leases/jobs left by failed upgrades
charts/private/README.md - document deprecation timeline and migration steps
charts/private/tests/templates_test.go - unit tests for template rendering (helm template based)
charts/private/values.yaml - bump default structure to new schema with comments
tests/e2e/upgrade_rollback_matrix.yaml - new e2e matrix to run upgrades from v0.9.x -> v1.0.0 variants
review_comments: Connor Myers (review): Can we keep the old init-job manifest around for a minor while and gate the hook with a feature flag? Some on-prem clusters have strict pod hook policies. Reply: We added aliasing and a chart-level opt-out flag 'hooks.enable=true|false' (default true). If set to false the old init-job path is kept behind templates/legacy-init-job.yaml. We documented this in README.

Diego Vargas (review): The pre-upgrade hook uses default service account; is there an RBAC change risk? Reply: Hook now uses a dedicated serviceAccount 'private-init-hook-sa' with minimal verbs; RBAC role added. We limited permissions to namespace-scoped lease/job operations. See charts/private/templates/rbac-hook.yaml

Priya Nair (review): CI flaked when rendering values.schema.json in go helm unit tests. Suggest pinning schema validator version. Reply: CI now vendorizes kubeval (v0.16.1) in the test container and we run 'kubeval --strict' in a separate CI step to make failures explicit.

QA (comment): e2e matrix detected a rollback where a leftover lease blocked re-install. This PR's rollback-cleanup-hook removed the lease and retry succeeded. Verified on k8s 1.25 and 1.26 clusters. Reply: Added test case to ensure lease deletion post-rollback.
release_notes: Stabilize Helm values schema and migration path for Private installer: adds values.schema.json, introduces aliasing for deprecated keys, migrates init job to Helm hooks with deterministic rollback cleanup, and documents deprecation/migration steps. No breaking changes by default; chart consumers can opt out of hook behavior with hooks.enable=false.
notes_for_release: Ops: recommend running 'helm lint --values values.yaml' and 'helm template' with kubeval validation before orchestrating upgrades. Customers on older private releases should follow charts/private/README.md migration steps.
